changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionConditionItemValue') BEGIN create table metrics.AssetVersionConditionItemValue ( [Uid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [Value] nvarchar(250) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItemValue PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC, [Value] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItemValue_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItemValue_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem FOREIGN KEY([Uid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] CHECK CONSTRAINT FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItemValue_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem END
